mappings.rationale: Code number and title are identical and unchanged across the 2020->2025 revision, confirmed bidirectionally: BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 5 (2020->2025 direction, p.144) and Lampiran 10 (2025->2020 reverse direction, p.336) both render the row '05200 Pertambangan Lignit | 05200 Pertambangan Lignit' with no code drift. The uraian describes a semantically self-contained lignite-mining scope -- underground/surface/liquefaction extraction plus quality-improving handling (crushing, washing, screening, mixing, compacting for transport/storage) -- with explicit exclusions carved out to coal-proper mining (0510), peat digging (0892), mining support services and coal drilling tests (0990), lignite-briquette manufacturing (1920), and land development/preparation for lignite mining (4312). This detailed, bounded uraian plus the identical-code bidirectional lampiran hit rules out a coincidental title-only match; there is no split/merge/collision signal in either crosswalk direction.

reasons: Bidirectional BPS crosswalk confirmed independently: Lampiran 5 (p.144/printed 130, 2020->2025 direction) and Lampiran 10 (p.336/printed 322, 2025->2020 reverse direction) both show '05200 Pertambangan Lignit' mapping to itself, code and title unchanged, exactly once in each direction.

No split/merge/collision signal for 05200 in either table -- contrasted directly against neighboring rows that DO show splits (05100->05101/05102 in Lampiran 5) and merges (many 2020 codes ->03300 in Lampiran 10), proving the tables are capable of showing such signals and 05200 has none.

canonical.json uraian text matches the proposal's rationale verbatim: underground/surface/liquefaction lignite extraction plus quality-improving handling, with exclusions to 0510 (coal), 0892 (peat), 0990 (support services/drilling tests), 1920 (briquette manufacturing), 4312 (land prep).

licensing_inherits=false independently corroborated against the established semantics of this field in the same lot's precedent docs (2026-07-18-kbli-batch-a-lot01-e1.md, 2026-07-17-kbli-pilot-a1-results.md): licensing_inherits=true is reserved for cases where the PP28 source pointer names a DIFFERENT/foreign code (e.g. 50115->pp28_source[51107], 60312->pp28_source[63912], both quarantined) or a real split/merge requiring aggregation. Here pp28_sources=['05200'] is self-referential (same code), and canonical.json's _l1_source/_source_relabeled fields confirm the licensing content is OSS-RBA-2025-native, not PP28-derived cross-code inheritance -- the same pattern that yielded licensing_inherits=false for sibling codes 01287/64110/47771.

pp28/ABSENT.json (11,208 pages / 21 files scanned, code truly absent from PP28 corpus) does not contradict the false licensing_inherits verdict because the declared pp28_sources pointer is self-referential/vestigial, not a foreign-code inheritance claim -- exactly the 01287 precedent ('the pointer is vestigial, not licensing-bearing').
needs_quarantine=false and confidence=high are both consistent with the clean, unambiguous, bidirectionally-confirmed 1:1 evidence -- no basis found to raise either flag.
